description: This file defines the OrdersFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying a list of orders in a RecyclerView. It manages UI setup, lifecycle events, and loading order data asynchronously using coroutines.

classes.name: OrdersFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of past and current orders along with their status in a RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, initializes RecyclerView and its adapter.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Triggers loading of orders when the fragment resumes, using a coroutine.

methods.name: loadOrders
methods.description: Fetches the list of orders from the repository and updates the adapter.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of OrdersFragment.
